brief: A straddle flagged the prior weekend realized 2x over 5 days. The straddle price doubled from 4% to 8.2%, pushing convexity to panic levels last seen in 2025's Liberation Day, 2020 Covid, the 2022 Fed hiking cycle, and the 2010 to 2011 European debt crises. Garrett calls this an "AI conviction crisis": the AI trade is not abandoned, but capital intensity, financing requirements, ROI and valuations are being questioned together. He still sides with Ben Snider that hyperscalers are the best vol-adjusted place to invest, hedged across a no-payback scenario and a payback-realized scenario. Positioning is already washed, with hedge fund nets at 1-year and 3-year lows and CTAs flipped net short after selling $57bn. He argues volume and implied vol spiking together has historically signaled a crescendo rather than a continuation, not a bottom call. Because the 6-week option breakeven already prices equities' long-run annualized return, he sees limited room for vol to rise further and recommends long-delta, vega-flat or net-short structures: window knock-outs, VIX calendar put spreads, knock-out calls, and short puts in top longs. Separately, cyclicals, up 12% YTD versus negative AI stocks, still trade 40% above their 2018 trough despite a 23% drawdown that quarter.
